ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white) to 55% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white patch occupying the superior two-thirds of the left lobe; fragmented white patches at the distal tip of the right lobe; central median region and lower lobe boundaries exhibit solid low-intensity black pigmentation with high-contrast stippling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate 50-degree internal angle and a pixel depth roughly one-quarter of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; left lobe displays smaller, tighter peak-to-valley amplitudes, while the right lobe distal edge exhibits larger, more pronounced jagged peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp upward-tapered points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of raised, high-contrast circular pixel groups (barnacles) on the extreme left lobe tip; discrete circular white rings (likely lamprey or barnacle scars) visible on the medial portion of the right lobe and lower section of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned vertical and diagonal white linear streaks (rake marks) cutting through the dark pigmentation on both lobes, most concentrated on the medial boundary of the left lobe and distal edge of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the left fluke tip; multiple circular parasite scars and widespread linear rake-mark scarring across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinct, isolated white circular ring scar located in the lower-central region of the right lobe pigmentation.
